responsibility: Enumerates the Darwin/Mach-O section descriptors used by GCC’s Darwin backend. Through DEF_SECTION entries it defines named sections for coalesced text/data, zero-sized object handling, literals, CFStrings, constructors/destructors, Objective-C metadata for multiple ABIs, Mach-O symbol stubs and pointer sections, and exception data. The file is declarative section-table input consumed by Darwin backend code, distinguishing it from darwin.cc which uses these definitions to choose and emit sections.
